description:
Welcome to The Proverbs Prepper — where biblical wisdom meets practical preparedness. 🌿

Learn simple, practical ways to prepare your home and family for emergencies, power outages, food and water shortages, and unexpected situations. 

Sally shares emergency preparedness tips, food and water storage, pantry essentials, cooking without electricity, useful household skills, and old-fashioned wisdom that still works today.

We prepare not from fear, but from wisdom, stewardship, and love for our families.

Faith • Prepare • Provide • Thrive

Subscribe and build a wiser, better-prepared household with me.
